requirements: Every input has a role, byte size, SHA-256 digest, dtype, shape, layout, endianness, and producer evidence identifier.
No digest is null, pending, inferred from a directory, or supplied only by a filename.
Every relative path resolves beneath the locked immutable input root.

fail_closed_conditions: Missing, duplicate, mutable, size-mismatched, or digest-mismatched input.
Shape, dtype, layout, endianness, or traversal-order mismatch.
Population count is not exactly 65,536 events.
NaN, infinity, floating-point exception, unexpected subnormal mode, or changed rounding mode.
Any executable or loaded object outside the sealed runtime root.
Any treatment dependency on a closed LibNC or NNCP runtime.
Any output path escape or pre-existing output mutation.

arithmetic.reference: scalar IEEE-754 with frozen source-order accumulation
arithmetic.bf16_conversion: Frozen integer bit operation; no platform library conversion.
arithmetic.tensor_serialization: Raw little-endian materialized element bit patterns with a canonical sidecar descriptor.
arithmetic.vectorized_path: Diagnostic only until every materialized output and checkpoint hash equals the scalar reference.

state_hashing.checkpoints: Every segment boundary plus all phase boundaries named by the planning contract.
state_hashing.first_divergence_window: One previous passing checkpoint and the first mismatching operation only.

implementation_rule: The first implementation must follow this interface without changing population, arithmetic, control semantics, checkpoint order, or terminal thresholds. Any probability-, state-, update-, or population-affecting correction requires a versioned correction-only successor.
